versos.e: A Danite, son of Manoah; miraculous birth of; a Nazarite from his mother’ s womb; the mother forbidden to drink wine or strong drink, or to eat any ceremonially unclean thing during gestation Jud 13:2-7,24,25
Desires a Philistine woman for his wife; kills a lion Jud 14:1-7
His marriage feast and the riddle propounded Jud 14:8-19
Is avenged for the estrangement of his wife Jud 15:3-8
Kills one-thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey Jud 15:13-17
Cohabits with Delilah, a prostitute; her machinations with the Philistines to over- come him Jud 16:1-20
Is blinded by the Philistines and confined to hard labor in prison; pulls down the pillars of the temple, meets his death, and kills a multitude of his enemies Jud 16:21-31; Heb 11:32
A judge (leader, hero) of Israel Jud 16:31
